leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the lung route directly to the left heart was frustrating because the labels matched, but the combination was unavailable.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the labelled lung return could not connect to the left heart until another part had been built.

arbitrary.text: That unavailable connection felt arbitrary at the time; the labels suggested it should work, but the prerequisite was not explained.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: tracing the two routes and seeing how the heart muscle gets its own supply made me curious about how other systems connect.
